data.name: Amooz
data.gender_notes: Amooz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'am' meaning 'to raise' or 'to command'. In the Islamic context, Amooz can be interpreted as 'the one who is raised or commanded by Allah'. This name is often given to boys to signify their noble and respected status in the eyes of Allah. The name Amooz carries the meaning “Noble, respectable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amooz usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, respectable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes obedience and submission to Allah's commands.
data.etymology: Amooz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, respectable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amooz total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: أموز
in_arabic.meaning: أموز تعني الشخص الذي يتعلم أو يدرس
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أموز مشتق من الجذر العربي 'أموز' والذي يعني الشخص الذي يتعلم أو يدرس، ويرتبط بالعلم والتعليم والفهم العميق للنصوص والعلوم الإسلامية. استخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية ليدل على الشخص الذكي والمتعلم.

in_urdu.name: اموز
in_urdu.meaning: اموز کا مطلب ہے سیکھنے والا یا طالب علم
in_urdu.long_meaning: اموز نام عربی جڑ 'أموز' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سیکھنے والا یا طالب علم۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافتوں میں ذہین اور تعلیم یافتہ فرد کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس کا تعلق علم اور تعلیم کی قدر سے ہے جو اسلامی تعلیمات میں بہت اہم ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अमोज़
in_hindi.meaning: अमोज़ का अर्थ है सीखने वाला या विद्यार्थी
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमोज़ नाम अरबी मूल 'أموز' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सीखने वाला या विद्यार्थी। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृतियों में बुद्धिमान और शिक्षित व्यक्ति के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। इसकी जड़ें शिक्षा और ज्ञान की कद्र में हैं, जो इस्लामी शिक्षाओं में महत्वपूर्ण है।

in_pashto.name: اموز
in_pashto.meaning: اموز د زده کوونکي یا محصل معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د اموز نوم د عربي ريښو 'أموز' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې ده زده کوونکي يا محصل. دا نوم د اسلامي کلتورونو په ډيرو کې د پوه او تعليم يافته کس د نښانې په توګه کارول کېږي. دا د علم او تعليم د قدر سره تړاو لري، کوم چې د اسلامي تعليماتو په منځ کې ډير مهم دی.

in_english.name: Amooz
in_english.meaning: Amooz means one who learns or a student
in_english.long_meaning: The name Amooz is derived from the Arabic root 'أموز', signifying one who learns or a student. It is used in various Islamic cultures to denote an intelligent and educated individual. The name is associated with the value of knowledge and learning, which is highly esteemed in Islamic teachings. Historically, names like Amooz were given to individuals who were known for their wisdom and scholarly pursuits.

This name holds a special place in the Muslim community due to its deep-rooted history and symbolic meaning. In certain Muslim countries, particularly Arabia, it is customary to give names with Arabic roots as they are believed to possess a cultural significance that strengthens the connection to the Islamic faith. This name on its own can evoke a sense of pride and prestige, as it is derived from the roots of Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Amooz (أموز) in Islam arises from its connection to Allah. As per the Islamic belief, every being is raised and commanded by Allah. By bestowing this name on a child, parents express their hope that their child is raised under the guidance and command of Allah. The name Amooz thus serves as a constant reminder to the child and those around him of his connection to Allah, inspiring him to live a life that reflects the teachings and values of Islam. The name is a reminder of Allah's presence and His ultimate power and control over all of creation.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Faqih al-Hamadhani mentioned Amooz as the capital of the Banu Ammarid Dynasty in the Maghreb region, around 1040 AD.
historical_references.context: The Islamic Empire was expanding in North Africa and the city of Amooz (modern day Oujda, Morocco) was the capital city of the Berber tribe known as the Banu Ammarid.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Idrisi referred to Amooz as a significant port city in the Maghreb, around 1154 AD. The name Amooz carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: During this period, the trade routes in the Mediterranean and the Atlantic were thriving and Amooz (modern day Oujda, Morocco) was an important port city in the Maghreb region.
